channel.title: The HOI Dispatch — High on Intelligence
channel.description: Notes from the frontier: launches, universes, Aethric architecture — from Hazem Soussi's High on Intelligence.

item.title: High on Intelligence is live
item.description: After weeks of stubbornness, High on Intelligence — Hazem Soussi's free, curated gateway into the technologies, information and data of this age — is public. 70 verified resources, five guided tracks, an on-device assistant, a written legitimacy policy.

item.title: The Universe Wing — a starfield built on Claude Opus
item.description: A real-time 3D starfield of 36 cataloged bright stars (J2000 coordinates) rendered with vendored three.js — plus HOI's six disciplines with the upgraded Claude Opus family: extended thinking, tool use, MCP, prompt contracts, evals, sovereign deployment.

item.title: Aethric: why a portal should survive its own death
item.description: GitHub Pages CDN live today, Aethric LAN mirror, Proxmox LXC origin pending — one static artifact, in git, pulled everywhere. Let's Encrypt for the public, our own CA strictly inside the LAN, and a status page that refuses to show green it didn't earn.
